{{Quote|In fact, when 'Emperor' Palpatine decided to arrest me for treason, one of his lapdog Senators informed Bail beforehand. Bail, while pretending to gloat with the swine, sent one of his men to warn me. I got off-planet about two minutes ahead of the ISB agents.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="RA" />}}
A '''member''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was<ref name="RA" /> loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escaped]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before signing the [[Corellian Treaty]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Therefore, the escape must have taken place in approximately 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] informed their peer, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], that Palpatine was planning to arrest [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] for [[Treason/Legends|treason]],<ref name="RA" /> as the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] had discovered her work in developing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the Empire.<ref name="Annual 1999">''[[Star Wars Annual 1999]]''</ref> Organa pretended to gloat with the senator, as the Alderaanian was publicly believed to be Mothma's [[Politics/Legends|political]] rival. Secretly, Organa was Mothma's ally in the Rebellion, so he dispatched a [[Unidentified male (Bail Organa)|man]] to inform Mothma of her imminent danger. She was able to [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escape]]<ref name="RA" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before ISB [[Agent/Legends|agents]] arrived to arrest her. Mothma later recalled the senator's unwitting role in her escape with derision, describing them as a "lapdog" and "[[swine]]."<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator was first mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[1990]].<ref name="RA" />
